brief:
Popular committees for refugees in Palestine said Saturday that statements from the "Peace Council" regarding the future of the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) represent a grave development, describing them as endorsing positions that seek to liquidate the Palestinian refugee cause, Shehab Wire reported.

The committees did not elaborate on specific statements or proposals from the Peace Council but characterized any effort to alter UNRWA's role as an attempt to eliminate the refugee issue from Palestinian political discourse.
